title: Stress-testing idealized QAOA against classical heuristics on 70 seeded weighted MaxCut graphs: a reproducibility and cost-accounting audit
description: Exploratory audit of 70 distinct seeded weighted MaxCut graphs (8–16 vertices). Brute-force and MILP reference optima agreed in 70/70. Ideal state-vector QAOA achieved 64/70 optima at p=1 and 61/70 at p=2; simulated annealing and tabu each achieved 65/70 under 256 final candidates. QAOA training required 7980 exact full-state expectation evaluations, an additional unequal cost. These are CPU simulation results, not evidence of quantum advantage; no QPU or independent blind validation.
